name: size-chart-maker
description: Make size-chart images for product pages from a measurement sheet. Open a CSV or Excel file with one row per size (S/M/L, 160/84A, 36…) and one column per measurement (chest, length, shoulder, sleeve…; numbers or ranges like 88-92). Typos such as a letter O instead of 0 and measurements that shrink as the size grows are flagged so you can fix them. Show centimetres, inches or both, headers in Chinese, English or both, pick a clean, bold or boutique style and highlight the recommended size, then export a sharp PNG, an SVG, an HTML table to paste into your shop page and a cleaned Excel file. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用尺寸数据做商品详情页的尺码表图片。打开 CSV 或 Excel 尺寸表：每行一个尺码（S/M/L、160/84A、36…），每列一项尺寸（胸围、衣长、肩宽、袖长…，可写数字或 88-92 这样的范围）。会标出把 0 打成字母 O 之类的错误，以及尺码变大尺寸反而变小的可疑数据，改好后再出图。可显示厘米、英寸或两者，表头中文、英文或中英，选简洁、醒目或精品样式，高亮推荐尺码，导出清晰的 PNG、SVG、可直接贴到店铺页面的 HTML 表格和整理后的 Excel。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
